DXC issue #1306 -- Validation for sync in varying flow control
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/1306

WHAT TO LOOK FOR

Compare the FXC pane against the two DXC panes.

FXC rejects this shader:

    error X3663: thread sync operation found in varying flow control,
    consider reformulating your algorithm so all threads will hit the
    sync simultaneously

Both DXC versions compile it silently and emit code. In the DXIL, the
barrier really is inside the divergent branch:

    br i1 %5, label %6, label %13
  ; <label>:6
    call void @dx.op.barrier(i32 80, i32 9)

The missing diagnostic is the feature request. Nothing here is broken
in DXC -- the analysis was simply never implemented.

The last pane is Clang, where HLSL support is being rebuilt, and where
a 2024 comment on this issue suggests the analysis would belong. It
compiles the shader silently too, so the gap is not yet closed in the
new front end either.
